result_text:
`PromotionService.createPromotion` now trims the code with `code.trim();` before it checks for a duplicate and saves. The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/service/PromotionService.java`.

A code pasted as `"  SPRING10 "` is now stored and listed as `SPRING10`, and a lookup by `SPRING10` finds it. Creating `SPRING10` a second time, with or without spaces, is rejected as a duplicate.

I ran the existing `Promotion*` tests and they passed. I didn't add a test for the trimming case.

I only changed creation. `limitToRegion` still looks up the code exactly as given, so a caller passing `" SPRING10 "` there would get "Unknown promotion code".
